metadata.title: Rural grid-extension and community planning benchmarks
metadata.warning: These are generic planning benchmarks, not Botswana tender rates. GridIQ exposes low/reference/high sensitivity and never labels the resulting cost as a BPC quotation.

sources.title: World Bank/ESMAP rural electrification benchmark
sources.note: Uses US$10,000/km for medium-voltage lines and US$5,000/km for LV distribution in its illustrative rural electrification calculation.

sources.title: World Bank MV expansion example
sources.note: Provides project-specific 30 kV line unit costs around US$20,985-US$27,129/km; used only as a high sensitivity bound.

households.source: Statistics Botswana Population and Housing Census 2022, Analytical Report Volume 2

community_demand.handling: VillageFit does not manufacture electrical demand. The user can provide a demand intensity or a future licensed benchmark; until then it sizes resource potential and grid-extension economics but labels kW/kWh system sizing unavailable.
